newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends lower on import requirements.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends lower on import requirements.

text.p: Bangladesh taka closed lower at 42.3800/42.3925 to the dollar in interbank trade on Monday against its previous close of 42.3400/42.3850, dealers said.

They said the taka slipped on demand for dollars from importers after opening at 42.3600/42.3900. "There was a moderate demand for dollars. The trading has just started picking up as the market is stabilising after Saturday's downward adjustment of the taka by the central bank," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed flat at 4.5 percent to 5.25 percent, dealers said. -- Dhaka Newsroom 880-2-506363
